cross_bank_exact_close_reaccept.repair: event_ready and window_close_ready are explicitly suppressed for an exact accepted-grace identity even when the alternate fill bank makes the request semantically legal

changed_payload_before_sampled_valid_low.reason: Requiring a sampled-low bubble between legal descriptors would destroy the frozen event II=1 objective.
changed_payload_before_sampled_valid_low.r2_rule: The exact accepted payload is grace-only and cannot reaccept. A different payload on the next edge is a new transaction: accept if semantically legal, otherwise fail closed in the same cycle.
changed_payload_before_sampled_valid_low.consequence: A legal changed row/base/context is not called an identity-mutation attack; invalid duplicate, range, context, collision, or unavailable-bank payloads remain attacks.
